From Wiktionary, the free dictionary
See also: finlandés and finlandès

Portuguese

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Finlândia +‎ -ês.

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /fĩ.lɐ̃ˈde(j)s/ [fĩ.lɐ̃ˈde(ɪ̯)s]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /fĩ.lɐ̃ˈde(j)s/ [fĩ.lɐ̃ˈde(ɪ̯)s]
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /fĩ.lɐ̃ˈde(j)ʃ/ [fĩ.lɐ̃ˈde(ɪ̯)ʃ]
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /fĩ.lɐ̃ˈdeʃ/

  • Rhymes: (Portugal) -eʃ
  • Hyphenation: fin‧lan‧dês

Adjective

[edit]

finlandês (feminine finlandesa, masculine plural finlandeses, feminine plural finlandesas, not comparable)

  1. Finnish (pertaining to Finland or its people)

Noun

[edit]

finlandês m (plural finlandeses, feminine finlandesa, feminine plural finlandesas)

  1. Finnish (person from Finland)

Noun

[edit]

finlandês m (uncountable)

  1. Finnish (language)
